# QueueBuzz

> QueueBuzz is a virtual queue management platform for physical businesses. Customers join a digital waitlist from a QR code, shared link, or join code without downloading an app or creating an account.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://queuebuzz.com/): Product overview, core capabilities, use cases, and FAQs.
- [Pricing](https://queuebuzz.com/pricing): Current subscription plans and included features.
- [Premium](https://queuebuzz.com/premium): Advanced queue-management capabilities.
